name: Small covered jar
dimensions: with cover: H. 12 x Diam. 8.4 cm (4 3/4 x 3 5/16 in.)
summary: Covered cylindrical jar with three small triangular tabs descending from a flat rim, the conical cover with conical-dish shaped knob; thinly potted gray earthenware with abstract decoration cold-painted in red pigment. Dawenkou culture. From the middle and lower Yellow River valley regions; Shandong, northern Jiangsu, northern Anhui, and eastern Henan provinces.
